title: Staged Fuel-Cycle Strategy Initiated
description: Kronos launches its staged fuel-cycle strategy — bridging a brief deuterium–tritium commissioning stage toward low-neutron deuterium–helium-3 operation, with helium-3 bred in situ via catalyzed D–D (no breeding blanket).

title: Paul Weiss Elevated to Lead Material Sciences & Nano Technology
description: Dr. Paul Weiss, holder of the Fred Kavli Chair in NanoSystems Sciences, formally takes the helm of Material Sciences & Nano Technology.

title: Unveiling of the AI/ML-Powered Simulation Suite
description: Kronos unveils its AI/ML-powered simulation suite - the computational backbone that would grow into the company's digital twin.

title: Global Community Invited to Beta Test Algorithms
description: In an unusual move for a private fusion developer, Kronos opens its simulation suite to a global community of beta testers.

title: Alignment with the DOE Milestone-Based Fusion Program
description: Kronos aligns its development plan with the U.S. Department of Energy's Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program.

title: PUZZLE X 2023: The Helium-3 Dawn Presented
description: Founder Priyanca Ford delivers the keynote 'From Star Power to Earth: Helium-3 & the Dawn of the Fusion Era' at PUZZLE X in Barcelona.

title: Establishing the KFEDS Defense Security Posture
description: Kronos formalizes the KFEDS defense security posture, highlighting the resilience advantages of compact fusion for critical infrastructure.

title: Global Call for Supply Chain Partnerships
description: Kronos launches a Supply Chain Partnership Portal, marking the transition from design toward manufacturing readiness.

title: Jon Michel Greenwood Spearheads Digital Twin Architecture
description: CTO Jon Michel Greenwood elevates the Kronos simulation suite into a fully realized digital-twin platform.

title: World's First Component Factory Established in India
description: Kronos establishes its first Fusion Energy Component Factory in India, executing on international scaling.

title: Synergies with MagLab Enhance High-Temperature Superconductors
description: Work at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory advances characterization of the high-temperature superconducting (REBCO) tapes central to the magnet system.

title: "The Kronos Fusion Energy Podcast" Expands Educational Reach
description: 'The Kronos Fusion Energy Podcast,' hosted by Priyanca Ford, expands to demystify fusion and engage tier-one talent.

title: Dr. Gerald Kulcinski Champions the Aneutronic Vision
description: Fusion pioneer Dr. Gerald Kulcinski joins the podcast, validating the low-neutron D-3He pathway and its aneutronic p-11B endpoint.

title: Ruben Fair's Expertise Applied to Magnetic Shielding
description: Board advisor Ruben Fair brings three decades of magnet-design and magnetic-shielding expertise to the program.

title: Sushma Bhatia Steers Legislative and Environmental Strategy
description: Advisory board member Sushma Bhatia steers the company's legislative and environmental strategy.

title: Jack Dongarra Optimizes Exascale Computing Workflows
description: Turing Award winner Jack Dongarra advises on optimizing the exascale computing workflows behind the digital twin.

title: Simulation Validates Negative Triangularity Plasma Shaping
description: Kronos's simulation suite validates negative-triangularity plasma shaping for the S.M.A.R.T. reactor - suppressing edge instabilities without H-mode.

title: Priyanca Ford's Q1 Founder Update
description: Founder Priyanca Ford's Q1 update on the company's long-run ambitions and program direction.

title: Formal Introduction of the MetroVolt Urban Generator
description: Kronos formally introduces MetroVolt, its commercial urban fusion generator.

title: The AEGIS System for Modular Defense Applications
description: Kronos unveils AEGIS, a hardened, modular generator line for defense, remote, and critical-infrastructure missions.

title: The 5-Channel Direct Energy Conversion (DEC) Blueprint
description: Kronos publishes the complete engineering blueprint for its 5-channel Direct Energy Conversion system.

title: Channel 1 & 2: Electrostatic and MHD Extraction Maturation
description: DEC Channels 1 and 2 - electrostatic retarding-field and MHD extraction - mature through 2025 engineering.

title: Channel 3 & 4: Thermionic and Photovoltaic Energy Capture
description: DEC Channels 3 and 4 - thermionic emission and photovoltaic capture - finalize designs to harvest surface heat and radiation.

title: Expansion of the Simulation Suite to 12 Modules
description: The Kronos AI simulation suite expands to twelve interoperable modules spanning magnets, plasma, and balance-of-plant.

title: The Staged Fuel Cycle Strategy Solidified
description: Kronos solidifies its staged fuel-cycle strategy, bridging near-term commissioning toward low-neutron D-3He operation.

title: The Autonomous AI Stability System Detailed
description: Kronos details the design of its autonomous AI stability ('immune') system for real-time plasma control.

title: Entering the Pre-Commercial Validation Stage
description: Kronos transitions out of conceptual R&D into the pre-commercial validation stage for the S.M.A.R.T. generator family.

title: The 2026 Tech Audit Presentation Delivered
description: Kronos delivers its 2026 Tech Audit - a full disclosure of generator physics and engineering.

title: 1-D Thermal Gradient and Vacuum Vessel Structural Analysis Published
description: Kronos publishes its 1-D thermal-gradient (1700 C plasma edge) data and full vacuum-vessel structural analysis.

title: The 20 K Closed-Cycle Cryogenic Network Design Locked
description: Kronos locks the design of its 20 K closed-cycle cryogenic network, eliminating liquid-helium infrastructure from the balance-of-plant.

title: Center-Stack Neutron Shield and Fluence Budget Analyzed
description: 2026 simulation campaigns analyze the shielded center-stack neutron-fluence budget for the low-neutron design — no breeding blanket required.

title: Microsecond AI Control Modeled for Vertical Displacement Events
description: Simulations show the microsecond AI digital twin can mitigate vertical displacement events (VDEs) in the design.

title: Load-Following Capability Modeled for Grid Integration
description: Kronos models load-following capability for grid integration in its design point, ahead of the gated program.

title: The Horizon: Toward Gate-Stage Hardware
description: As 2026 closes, Kronos looks ahead to its gated program — engaging vendors and the supply chain on the path from a validated design toward first hardware.
